finding.comment: the id guard precedes consumption, so a missing argument leaves holder.item intact; the consume-before-guard concern does not apply

files.patch:
--- a/FeatureDialog.kt
+++ b/FeatureDialog.kt
@@ -31,6 +31,10 @@
     fun launch(args: Bundle) {
+        val id = args.getString("id")
+        if (id == null) return
+        holder.item = null
+        open(id)
     }
